harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Configured a persistent Squid forward proxy on node1:3128. Node2 can retrieve the preserved handbook origin on node2:8081; other origins, other destination ports, and all CONNECT tunnels are denied. Both nodes rebooted sequentially and fully recovered with changed boot identities. RHEL 9.8 and kernel 5.14.0-687.20.1.el9_8 remain unchanged.
actions_performed: Installed the RHEL-compatible Squid 5.5 package on node1.
Configured Squid to accept node2 only, allow only node2:8081, deny CONNECT, and deny all remaining requests.
Created and enabled a hardened systemd service for the existing staged origin on node2.
Added persistent source-restricted firewalld rules for node2→node1:3128 and node1→node2:8081.
Verified allowed, wrong-port, wrong-origin, and CONNECT behavior.
Restarted node1 and node2 individually and verified changed boot IDs and complete recovery.

evidence.requirement: Persistent HTTP proxy on node1 TCP 3128
evidence.summary: Squid configuration parsed successfully, the enabled service listened on 3128, and the firewall admitted node2 only.

evidence.requirement: Preserve and serve the approved handbook through the proxy
evidence.summary: Staged file hashes remained identical, the origin listened on 8081, and the expected handbook was retrieved directly and through the proxy before and after restart.

evidence.requirement: Allow only the approved origin on TCP 8081; reject other ports, origins, and CONNECT
evidence.summary: Approved HTTP returned 200; wrong port, wrong origin, and CONNECT returned 403. Squid logs recorded TCP_MISS/200 and TCP_DENIED/403 outcomes.

evidence.requirement: Keep the installed OS release and kernel
evidence.summary: Both nodes remained on RHEL 9.8 with kernel 5.14.0-687.20.1.el9_8.
Boot ID changed from 910dc564-cb62-46fc-8290-c332e63d6201 to eab2cc27-90a1-4b07-a034-b72f84e24dc9; Squid, firewall policy, listener, and proxied handbook retrieval recovered.
Boot ID changed from 34027437-307c-4f58-bdb2-1fe626bb2d66 to 3ba8bb66-aa43-4e00-80a5-47479fc2a853; origin service, staged data, listener, firewall rule, and direct/proxied access recovered.
